title: Weighted Decline Crunch
summary: A crunch on a decline bench holding a plate, for loaded ab work.

equipment_needs.text: Needs: decline bench; weight plates or dumbbells.

muscles.why: Library rating 1 for abs (main mover): each working set adds 1 of a set to the weekly abs total.
Library rating 0.3 for obliques (minor): each working set adds 0.3 of a set to the weekly obliques total.

setup.text: Hook your feet on the decline bench and hold a plate at your chest.
Curl your ribs toward your pelvis to lift your upper back.
Lower slowly until your abs stretch.

form_cues.cue: Curl the torso up one vertebra at a time
Curl up. Don't swing up by pulling with the hips.

mistakes.text: Pulling up with the hip flexors instead of curling.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds no ramp-up sets; make the first working set a touch lighter if you like.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 10% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 10-15 reps, stopping about 2 reps short of failure (RIR 2). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Pick a variation and range you can train comfortably.

alternatives.goal_label: Home gym: no equipment / bar only
